body.probe_summary: Built a Playwright headless-firefox harness that signs in, refreshes, and asserts /api/me returns 200. Failure reproduces every run.
assumptions: Token in localStorage at refresh time matches what the server issued.

diagnosis.feedback_loop_description: Playwright firefox launches the dashboard, signs in via mocked SSO, hard-refreshes, and asserts /api/me returns 200. The harness fails reliably with 401.

ranked_hypotheses.statement: After refresh, the in-memory auth store is empty for one tick before localStorage rehydration. The interceptor reads from the in-memory store and sends an empty Authorization header.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: If H-1 is correct, then awaiting rehydration before the first request after refresh will make the bug disappear; logging the header value at request time will show an empty string.

ranked_hypotheses.statement: Firefox's restored localStorage on refresh occurs after the dashboard's first XHR fires; Chrome restores it earlier.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: If H-2 is correct, then logging Date.now() at localStorage read vs first XHR start in both browsers will show Firefox reads happening after the first XHR.

ranked_hypotheses.statement: An axios interceptor mutates the headers object across requests, and a Firefox-specific request retry strips the header before the second attempt.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: If H-3 is correct, then disabling the retry interceptor will make the bug disappear; capturing both attempts will show different Authorization headers.

probe_commands.purpose: Run the probe harness in headless Firefox to confirm the 401 reproduces.
